snippet.title: The Bureau of Fantastical & Arcane Affairs - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: Step into the clerk’s cubicle of destiny in The Bureau of Fantastical & Arcane Affairs. You’re an inspector in a world where fantasy tales are audited, quests are certified, and villains must file zoning permits. Get your paperwork in order, inspect magical forests, rant at careless necromancers and monsters, and when the story is finally “approved” you’ll step into the hero’s boots and see what chaos your decisions unleashed.
